members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The text, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting text, when the field controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new text each time it changes, including the empty string when Escape or the clear button empties the field.

members.name: onSubmit
members.doc: Called with the current text when Enter is pressed, including an empty string. A read-only field does not submit.

members.name: onClear
members.doc: Called after Escape or the clear button empties a field that had text.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its text stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed, submitted, or cleared.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits its text with the form.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: An example value shown while the field is empty. It does not name the field.

members.name: inputProps
members.doc: Native props for the inner input, such as keyboard, paste, focus, and selection handlers, and a className that merges with Mux UI's. The field owns its value, name, type, accessible name, validation, disabled, readOnly, and required, so inputProps cannot replace them.

types.name: FieldValidationProps

members.doc: Shown only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed validation, and replaces the built-in message; it never makes the field invalid by itself.
